I would love to live one day as my mom when she was my age. She came from a very comfortable, wealthy family, but chose to marry my dad who came from a humble background ,purely out of love. She faced challenges, stood by him against her own family, and last year when we lost my dad, she held his hand till his last breath. He even apologised in his final days for not giving her the life she once dreamed of… but my mom never expected anything from him. Her love was so unconditional and rare. Living a day as her would show me what real strength, sacrifice, and love look like. ❤

If I ever get a chance to become something, I would choose to become my old self again. I’ve been fighting a long-term health issue for a very long time, and because of that I haven’t felt like myself — mentally or emotionally. I stay quiet, I feel low, and happiness doesn’t come easily anymore. I just want to feel healthy, confident, and genuinely happy again.
Watching your content truly helps me. Whether it’s your hair care, skin care or your travel vlogs — everything feels warm, real, and comforting. Your videos give me positivity and motivation to keep going, especially on days when I feel low. Thank you for sharing your life so honestly and beautifully. It means more than you know 🤍✨

If I ever got the chance to live one day as someone else, I would choose to be an Indian Army officer🫡
I’ve always held deep respect for our soldiers, their courage, discipline, and the way they carry the nation in their hearts every single moment. It was once my dream to join the Army too, but life had different plans for me.
Still, that admiration has never left me. I often wonder what it feels like to wear that uniform with pride, to wake up with a sense of duty so strong, and to serve with a kind of selflessness that is rare in this world
Living a single day in their shoes would be a reminder of the bravery and sacrifice that protect every one of us, every day.

If I had to live as another person for a day, I would choose my grandmother. She is incredibly strong mentally, and for years it has just been me, my mom, and my grandma. She has always been the steady pillar of our family. I don’t know if I’ll ever have the same courage she has, but I hope to live like her one day. She is so sweet and takes care of everything and everyone as if they were her own. What amazes me most is how she gives so much love without ever expecting anything in return.

I would love to live one day like Lorelai Gilmore from Gilmore Girls. I love how she’s fearless, a cool mom, and someone who built her life on her own terms. She does everything by herself, doesn’t let society’s expectations define her, and always stands up for who she is. That, to me, is the truest form of self-love. I want to tap into that energy — the confidence, the independence, the humor, and the unapologetic authenticity that Lorelai embodies every single day.
